_schema: each entry: sha256, provenance_class, regenerable_here, note
_note: numba-only package; the calibration surface is a frozen external input and is never regenerated here.

cbar_surface.csv.note: finite-sample calibration surface c-bar(m,T), 854 rows (const+maic arms); built externally over ~142 wall-hours; the package renders tab:cbar from it and never regenerates it

ppp_panel.csv.note: 8 real exchange rates 1973-2024 (BIS + World Bank); rebuildable from the sources in DATA_TERMS.md

exog_dates.csv.note: per-currency regime-break dates, hand-sourced (Plaza Accord, Black Wednesday, ...); the tab:dates producer

ppp_ar_diagnostic.csv.note: AR-order diagnostic on ppp_panel.csv (T=52, 1973-2024 window), read by the empirical door

DATA_TERMS.md.note: data provenance and terms; travels with ppp_panel.csv

boot_out/calib/surface_ppp_boot.csv.note: sieve-bootstrap PPP surface (m=2,T=52); the frozen source rendered into tab:pppsurface

OBJECT_MAP.csv.note: number -> producer -> artefact -> digest, the machine-readable reproduction map (18 objects, incl. tab:cv-full full M-class percentile table)

limiting_density.csv.note: Fig S1 limiting null-law density (panel,T,m,x,y); generated by the heavy replicate_section3_4.py --limiting-density MC (kernel), which lives in construction -- shipped frozen (decision a), the package renders Figure_S1 from it and does not regenerate it.

ppp_sweep/sweep_gates.csv.note: series-by-series admissibility attrition (C1-C5 gates) over the BIS universe; produced by the ppp_sweep_bis.py --fetch sweep (needs the BIS bulk export), shipped frozen -- the manuscript's 'attrition table, series by series, in the replication package' (supplement).
